info.name: SIH-26135 Analytics Backend API
info.description:
### SIH-26135 Unified Trainee Tracking, Verification, Analytics & Governance Engine

Comprehensive Postman collection covering 100% of the production API operations (386 operations across 250 paths).

**Organization**:
- `1-core-domain`: Master entities, Trainees, Centers, Providers, Batches, Consents, Auth (151 ops)
- `2-workflows`: Candidate Lifecycle, Placement-to-Employment, Verification, Skill Gap, Follow-up (86 ops)
- `3-analytics-exports`: Dashboards (Q01–Q22), Fact/Summary read-models, streaming CSV/JSON exports with k=5 SDC (78 ops)
- `4-operations-governance`: Immutable Audit Trails, Data Quality Rules & Issues, Bulk CSV Ingestion (57 ops)
- `5-external-communication`: Durable Dispatch Queue, Delivery Logs, Templates, Inbound Webhooks (14 ops)

**Authentication**:
Stateless Bearer JWT. Execute `1. Core Domain -> Authentication -> Login` to automatically populate `{{accessToken}}` and `{{refreshToken}}`.
